items.title: feat: First-class OpenRouter LLM provider (latency-first routing)
items.summary:
## Why
The LLM content filter runs **synchronously in the `/api/send` request path**: the frontend waits for it, with a default `LLM_TIMEOUT` of 5000 ms, and a timeout goes through the key's fail mode (`block` → 503). The model's output is tiny (`max_tokens: 200`, a small JSON verdict), so end-to-end **latency** matters more than throughput or per-token cost.
